en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional humorous song; the second version has the husband beat his wife with a stick instead of fetching the food, as I read it. 'Манџија' (I rendered 'gourmand'), 'суровица' and 'недокастрена' are guesses; the '?' is in the source text.

lines.en: - Hey, my husband, hey, gourmand,
hey, handsome you ?,

lines.cyr: кажи ми мажу што ти се јаде,
lines.lat: kaži mi mažu što ti se jade,
lines.en: tell me, husband, what you feel like eating,
so we can have supper?
- Hey, wife, beautiful Ilchovitsa,
my first great love,

lines.cyr: мене ми се јаде пресна погача
lines.lat: mene mi se jade presna pogača
lines.en: I feel like eating fresh flatbread
that a bride has kneaded,

lines.cyr: мене ми се јаде печена кокошка
lines.lat: mene mi se jade pečena kokoška
lines.en: I feel like eating roast chicken
that has not yet been carried out.

lines.cyr: - И нас ни се јаде пресна погача
lines.lat: - I nas ni se jade presna pogača
lines.en: - We too feel like eating fresh flatbread
that a bride has kneaded,

lines.cyr: и нас ни се јаде печена кокошка
lines.lat: i nas ni se jade pečena kokoška
lines.en: we too feel like eating roast chicken
that has not yet been carried out.
Hey, my husband, hey, gourmand,
hey, handsome you ?,

lines.cyr: кажи ми мажу што ти се пие,
lines.lat: kaži mi mažu što ti se pie,
lines.en: tell me, husband, what you feel like drinking,
so we can drink our fill?
- Hey, wife, beautiful Ilchovitsa,
my first great love,

lines.cyr: мене ми се пие лута ракија
lines.lat: mene mi se pie luta rakija
lines.en: I feel like drinking strong rakija
aged five years,

lines.cyr: мене ми се пие тригодишно вино
lines.lat: mene mi se pie trigodišno vino
lines.en: I feel like drinking three-year-old wine
racked three times.

lines.cyr: - И нас ни се пие лута ракија
lines.lat: - I nas ni se pie luta rakija
lines.en: - We too feel like drinking strong rakija
aged five years,

lines.cyr: и нас ни се пие тригодишно вино
lines.lat: i nas ni se pie trigodišno vino
lines.en: we too feel like drinking three-year-old wine
racked three times.
Oh my husband, dear head of the house,
I would die for you.

lines.cyr: Ах мори жено, жалба ми падна,
lines.lat: Ah mori ženo, žalba mi padna,
lines.en: Oh wife, a complaint has fallen on me,
tell me what has happened to you?

lines.cyr: Ах мори жено, жалба ми падна,
lines.lat: Ah mori ženo, žalba mi padna,
lines.en: Oh wife, a complaint has fallen on me,
tell me what you feel like eating?

lines.cyr: Мене ми се јаде пресна погача,
lines.lat: Mene mi se jade presna pogača,
lines.en: I feel like eating fresh flatbread
that a bride has kneaded.

lines.cyr: Мене ми се јаде печена кокошка,
lines.lat: Mene mi se jade pečena kokoška,
lines.en: I feel like eating roast chicken
that has not yet been carried out.

lines.cyr: Мене ми се пие тригодишно вино,
lines.lat: Mene mi se pie trigodišno vino,
lines.en: I feel like drinking three-year-old wine
racked three times.

lines.cyr: Јас ти слегов долу во избата,
lines.lat: Jas ti slegov dolu vo izbata,
lines.en: I went down into the cellar,
where the wood is kept,
and took a green switch,
not yet fully trimmed (my reading),
it strikes ten times, counts once,
not yet fully trimmed (my reading).
Here you are, wife, fresh flatbread
that a bride has kneaded.
Here you are, wife, roast chicken
that has not yet been carried out.
Here you are, wife, three-year-old wine
racked three times.
